notes.title: Bashed.OS - Time for an update announcement.
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Bashed.OS has been recently quiet, as I'm working on a new project, but seeming enough, I feel it's update time!

Bashed.OS will be having another game built into it. A prologue! And it's FREE!

The prologue is still in early development, and I have plans for it. It will be another mode to play, and is optional. And it unlocked whenever the game is started. So, it's not at all a worry!

The project is still in works, as it just started while writing this! It's inspiration, you can join my Discord for news, and ask questions! The original Bashed.OS game will be updated as well.

Such as a major graphic update! This is something I wanted to do for a bit, you'll see a step above it! Thankfully, it's simple for the players! Thank you for the time!

A lot more will be announced as soon as I have news!

notes.title: Big Update Rolling Out! Bashed.OS 2.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here's the patch-notes for a major update for Bashed.OS, another patch with an extra few things is coming as well! This isn't the final big update for Bashed!

--------------------------------------------
Content Updates -

- Outside Mechanic! This is new, to go outside, look to your left and press the M1 button to head outside! This will help you gain some time and distraction. A radio is outside, turn it on after a good while to distract whatever!

- NEW Ending!

- HARD Mode!

- New documents, there's a few!

- New Enemy, that's right! This one just comes from the shadows! Literally! Watch your step.

- Ending Edit, meaning there is a new part of the ending! 

Bug Fixes/Adjust

- Adjusted AI balance once more, this should give the player more time to do whatever instead of hiding most of the time. 

- Added sounds to alert the player more. This should help the player figure out ques and such.

- Added extra sounds!

- Adjusted some audio.

- Fixed issue regarding infinite hiding abuse and using the laptop while doing so. 

- Fixed some mouse locking issues. 

- Fixed some issues regarding misc.

- Fixed a big lighting issue that happened in game. Wasn't noticeable as much, but. Was annoying to me, hahah. 

--------------------------------------------

Update is rolling out, give it about half an hour to an hour!

notes.title: Balance Update Patch Notes: Bashed.OS 1.5
notes.notes:
Heya!

So, balance update. Let me speak about this.

Easier Code Locations

It is kinda hard to find some of these codes, especially for people that are new completely. This is basically a balance on some you will not have to find a clickable to find one, some will be in plain sight, So, this will be easier to handle! Clickables are still here, but not as consistent on codes. 

Scrolling Balance

This is mostly for the document tab, the documents have been added a way to counter if you've been to a certain page, completely. Scrolling and dragging was a little downfall, but this update will be changing that completely. You can scroll faster, and place faster. Perfect!

New Enemy!

Well, not really a new enemy to fend off. But, someone may or may not be stalking from aside, just take a good listen at times. Maybe you can hear something walking around, no need to fend off. I think he's just around..

Some new documents, in general!

Added a few of these extra ones, may or may not have a code within one of them! Hope that's blast itself, have fun searchin'!

Ending Change

New ending in general, as well. A few things were mentioned, and I'm very glad about this. Nobody has managed to beat it, and that is why this patch is coming along. 

Finally, Achievements.

A few of these are being worked on, which is nice! I'm glad about this. A few will be added along, such as ending and all. Which is just perfectly amazing!


Other than a few of these, this will be coming along very soon. Expect it very soon!

notes.title: Balance Update - Big Update Regarding Balance
notes.notes:
Hey there,

once again, another thanks to a certain fellow who played giving big feedback. Either way, this isn't fully what's coming to the future of Bashed, but. This is just something small to the future. 

Now, let's see these notes.

------------------------------------

Balance Update:

- Changed the spawn-rate of the Tall Man, should be a lot easier to browse, without seconds after spawning.

- Changed Spawn-Rate of the Short Man, he should be activated a bit less now, as well.

- Decreased the time it takes to close the door, used to be 8 secs, now it is 5 secs!

- Added a New Tutorial Mode, can be accessed through the Main-Menu only. 

- Added a few extra things that can happen around the player!

- Added extra explanation in the How-To-Play, for people who prefer reading than visuals.

- Added a way to see what documents you have already viewed, they are called flags. Use these flags to place them on each document you have already been in. 


--------------------------------------

notes.title: Release - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Bashed.OS! 

More than a few updates will be coming along, if you encounter a bug, please post it in the community tab, and I'll figure things out. Back to business. 

---------------------------------------------------

 BASHED.OS 1.1



- Added Extra Level, just for more gameplay!
- Added Extra Documents

- Added New Video (Torture Scene)

- Added New Ending, with story sum-up.

- Added Extra Locations with secrets, such as Network/Music Tabs

- Added Hiding Mechanic, new way to counter!

- Added extra lights, and balancing for better performance. 

- Fixed an issue for door opening, and Enemy Spawning right away.

- Fixed the whole issues regarding opening the PC and being able to ignore the enemy.

-Fixed issue with spawning outside from the house.

- Fixed some small crashes out.

- Fixed exploit and only exploit to where player can enter the PC while hiding, this was a little tough, but. It managed to work out without creating more bugs. 

- Revamped the main-menu screen, instead of a simple click and freeze, it adds more. Along added and changed the menu screen and background of it. 

- Added new Main Menu animation, this goes for the patch above, too!

- Added cross-hair to help the player navigate in the room, this helps regarding the safe, and along hiding and interacting. 

- Fixed some lighting issues on some pieces of the game. 

- Did some tweak to a little animation on the menu, and in-game.

More updates are coming, regarding balance if there is needed any balance! And along content updates, and these content updates will all be free. More levels, meaning different code location, and interacting on the PC. Perhaps more files. 

Thank you so much for having interest in Bashed.OS!
